threat_event: Attacker signs in to the shared ticketing account and exports customer records and ticket notes holding device passcodes, account passwords, and card numbers; then texts customers fake payment links
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One shared SYS-01 administrator login with MFA off; password known to the fill-in technician and never changed; about 3,100 passcodes, 85 account passwords, and 4 card numbers in free-text notes
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01; 5,600 customer records; BP-01, BP-03, BP-05
regulatory_driver: N81-R02 (Fla. Stat. 501.171(2)-(5)); N81-R01 (15 U.S.C. 45(n)); N81-R03 (SAQ P2PE eligibility)
existing_controls: Owner uses a password manager; vendor logs sign-ins
treatment_plan: Named fill-in account without export rights; change the password; MFA on; restricted passcode field cleared at release; stop collecting account passwords; purge historical notes and card numbers

threat_event: Customer device data on the bench PC or transfer drives is stolen in a break-in, read by someone at the bench, or taken by malware
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bench PC has no password and no encryption; drives unencrypted; about 1.6 TB from about 350 jobs since 2021 never deleted
treatment_plan: Password and lock now; full-disk encryption; hardware-encrypted drives; delete copies 14 days after delivery; purge the backlog with an SP 800-88 Rev. 2 method and a record

threat_event: Malware on a customer device under repair spreads over the shop Wi-Fi to the bench PC, tablet, or laptop
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One flat Wi-Fi network for business devices, the terminal, customer devices, and customers' phones; default router admin password; router firmware never updated
treatment_plan: Guest network for customers; separate bench network for customer devices; change router password; update firmware

threat_event: The fill-in technician browses or copies customer device content or customer records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written agreement or confidentiality terms; full access through the owner's login; no logging that tells the two users apart; passcodes on paper tags
affected_asset_or_process: Customer devices in custody; SYS-01; SYS-06
existing_controls: Cameras at the counter and bench
treatment_plan: Written agreement with confidentiality and access rules; named account; customer data access rules in POL-01 8.4; monthly log review

threat_event: Recycling drop-off devices leave the shop with recoverable customer data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Factory reset only when time allows; no record per device; no verification; lot-level certificates only
treatment_plan: SP 800-88 Rev. 2 procedure: clear or purge by device type, verify, log each serial number; physical destruction by the recycler for dead devices

threat_event: Card numbers recorded outside the P2PE terminal are exposed, and the shop loses SAQ P2PE eligibility
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Phone-payment card numbers written on sticky notes with the security code; 4 card numbers typed into ticket notes; no written card-handling rule
existing_controls: P2PE terminal for all keyed payments
treatment_plan: Key phone payments straight into the terminal while the caller waits; never write them down; shred the 6 old notes; purge the 4 notes and add a ticket-note warning

threat_event: The card terminal is tampered with or swapped for a skimming device
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Terminal never inspected; no record of its serial number; it sits on the counter within customers' reach
existing_controls: Terminal in the locked cabinet overnight
treatment_plan: Record make, model, and serial number; weekly inspection log; read the PIM tamper checks; verify any service visit with the processor

threat_event: A customer complaint or FTC inquiry finds the intake form promise "We never access your personal data" untrue
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: The intake form wording does not match what testing and data transfer require
treatment_plan: Rewrite the intake notice to say what access testing and transfers need and what never happens; make it true through POL-01 8.4

threat_event: Customer data pasted into the consumer AI assistant is kept or used for training by the vendor, or a wrong AI suggestion leads to an unneeded repair
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Consumer plan with training on; ticket notes, logs, and screen photos pasted since 2026-02; no review rule for AI suggestions
treatment_plan: Training off now; no personal data in prompts; business plan with no-training terms; technician confirms every diagnosis (P10)

threat_event: The owner is suddenly unavailable (illness or injury) or loses the only phone, so nobody can open SYS-01 or return about 25 customer devices
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One person holds every role and credential; MFA codes on one phone; no device-return procedure
existing_controls: Fill-in technician available about 12 days a year
treatment_plan: Named fill-in account; sealed emergency access sheet and recovery codes with the designated emergency contact; device-return procedure; weekly printed custody list (P05)

threat_event: Ticketing platform outage lasts longer than one business day
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SaaS dependency for tickets and checkout
existing_controls: Vendor availability commitments (SOC 2, P09); paper intake forms
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Keep numbered paper intake forms and print the custody list weekly

threat_event: A security incident is not recognized, or a Florida 30-day notice deadline or the processor's 24-hour notice is missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident plan, log, or contact list; no security training
treatment_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook and printed contact list; incident log; annual training and runbook walkthrough

threat_event: The camera account is taken over, or bench recordings of device screens (passcodes being entered, photos) are viewed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Camera account password only; bench camera can see device screens; 30-day cloud retention
existing_controls: Unique password in the password manager
treatment_plan: Turn on MFA; re-aim the bench camera to show hands and bench, not screens

threat_event: Hurricane closes the shop for several days and damages devices in custody
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single storefront; customer devices on site
existing_controls: SaaS reachable from home; locked cabinet
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. When a storm watch is issued, text customers to collect devices, move the rest into the cabinet off the floor, and take the laptop and drives home

threat_event: A phishing email or fake supplier invoice leads to a fraudulent payment or malware on the laptop
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No security training; supplier payment changes accepted by email
existing_controls: MFA on email, accounting, and bank; antivirus
treatment_plan: Annual training; call the supplier at a known number before any bank-detail change
